devices.title: ATMOSPHERE AIR STATION — PHYSICAL WIRING
devices.subtitle: Exact purchased boards • component side up • XIAO USB-C at top • 5 V USB power

connections.instruction: XIAO 3V3 → BME680 VCC + SCD41 VDD + VEML7700 VIN
XIAO GND → every module GND
XIAO D4/SDA → all three SDA holes
XIAO D5/SCL → all three SCL holes
XIAO VBUS/5V → PMS breakout VCC(+5V)
XIAO D6/TX → PMS breakout RXD (UART is crossed)
PMS breakout TXD → XIAO D7/RX (UART is crossed)
External wall adapter → USB-C cable → XIAO USB-C

assembly_notes: The PMS5003's supplied keyed 8-wire cable plugs into the sensor and the breakout; do not rearrange its conductors.
On the red PMS breakout, trust the printed hole labels—not cable colors.
Leave every gray X/NC hole empty. Power the PMS5003 from VBUS/5V, never 3V3.

devices.title: PRESENCE POD — PHYSICAL WIRING
devices.subtitle: Exact purchased boards • component side up • XIAO USB-C at top • 5 V USB power

connections.instruction: XIAO D3 → DHT11 + (switched 3.3 V power)
XIAO D2 → DHT11 OUT
XIAO GND → DHT11 − + VEML7700 GND + LD2410C GND
XIAO 3V3 → VEML7700 VIN
XIAO D4/SDA → VEML7700 SDA
XIAO D5/SCL → VEML7700 SCL
XIAO VBUS/5V → LD2410C VCC
XIAO D6/TX → LD2410C RX (UART is crossed)
LD2410C TX → XIAO D7/RX (UART is crossed)
External wall adapter → USB-C cable → XIAO USB-C

assembly_notes: LD2410C pin order is TX, RX, OUT, GND, VCC left-to-right with its silkscreen readable.
Aim the LD2410C antenna/component face toward the case's thin radar window.
Leave VEML7700 3Vo and LD2410C OUT empty. Power radar from VBUS/5V, never 3V3.

devices.title: CLIMATE POD — PHYSICAL WIRING
devices.subtitle: Exact purchased boards • top and underside XIAO views • 1S LiPo • two-resistor divider

connections.instruction: XIAO D3 → DHT11 + (switched 3.3 V power)
XIAO D2 → DHT11 OUT
XIAO GND → DHT11 − and one lead of R2
Meter-verified pigtail + wire → underside BAT+; the same BAT+ node → R1
Meter-verified pigtail − wire → underside BAT−
R1 other lead + R2 other lead join at XIAO D0/A0
USB-C is only for flashing/charging; it is not a permanent internal wire

assembly_notes: R1 = 200 kOhm from BAT+ to A0. R2 = 200 kOhm from A0 to GND. Both resistors are external and required.
Do not trust connector colors or shell orientation: unplug everything and verify +/− with a multimeter before soldering.
Solder the underside BAT pads and divider before applying mounting tape; insulate every exposed splice with heat-shrink.
